_note: v2.8 plan 69 K12, review 2026-10-16 #3 (no-model lane WITH the story-orchestrator-lore plugin installed and enableServerPlugins on): another page's write lands between this page's preflight read and its save. The fetch wrapper performs that write the moment the story's conditional commit is sent, so the server already holds it when the commit arrives. Treatment: the commit answers 409, the story posts no /api/worldinfo/edit, the other page's edit survives and the gated entry stays off; re-entering the checkpoint lands the write with the edit kept. Fails without the plugin by design (the status probe throws). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-69-k12-commit-race.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const K = 'SO-V28-69 K12R Book'; if (wi.world_names.includes(K)) throw new Error('fixture book already exists: ' + K); const entry = (uid, comment, key, content) => ({ uid, comment, key, keysecondary: [], content, constant: false, selective: true, disable: false, position: 1, depth: 4, order: 100, probability: 100, useProbability: true }); await wi.createNewWorldInfo(K); await wi.saveWorldInfo(K, { entries: { 0: entry(0, 'Gate entry', ['gate'], 'K gated text'), 1: entry(1, 'Other', ['harbor'], 'other-original'), 2: entry(2, 'Control', ['dock'], 'control-original') } }, true); const server = async (name) => { const r = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }), cache: 'no-cache' }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('server read failed for ' + name + ': ' + r.status); return r.json(); }; const otherPage = async (uid, text) => { const data = await server(K); data.entries[uid].content = text; const r = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/edit', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: K, data }) }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('other-page write failed: ' + r.status); }; const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const root = (ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings ??= {}); globalThis.__k12r = { wi, K, server, otherPage, pause, was: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.worldInfo ?? {})) }; await globalThis.storyOrchestratorScanGating.requestFile(); return { mode: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode };

import_story.title: SO-V28-69 K12R
import_story.description: Plan 69 K12 no-model fixture: a checkpoint that enables an entry of the story book in file mode.

steps.eval: const k = globalThis.__k12r; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); const status = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-lore/status', { headers: SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders() }); if (!status.ok) throw new Error('this scenario needs the story-orchestrator-lore server plugin; status answered ' + status.status); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && (await k.server(k.K)).entries[0].disable !== true; i += 1) await k.pause(200); const rest = (await k.server(k.K)).entries[0].disable; if (rest !== true) throw new Error('file mode did not start the gated entry off: disable=' + rest); await k.pause(1500); return { plugin: await status.json(), gateRestsOff: true };

const k = globalThis.__k12r; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await k.wi.loadWorldInfo(k.K); const calls = []; const original = globalThis.fetch; let raced = false; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''); const kind = url.includes('/story-orchestrator-lore/commit') ? 'commit' : url.includes('/api/worldinfo/edit') ? 'edit' : url.includes('/api/worldinfo/get') ? 'get' : null; let name = null; if (kind) { try { name = JSON.parse(String(init?.body ?? 'null'))?.name ?? null; } catch {} } if (kind === 'commit' && name === k.K && !raced) { raced = true; globalThis.fetch = original; await k.otherPage(1, 'race-edit'); globalThis.fetch = wrapped; } const response = await original(input, init); if (kind && name === k.K) calls.push({ kind, status: response.status }); return response; }; const wrapped = globalThis.fetch; let activated; try { activated = await rt.activateCheckpoint('open'); await k.pause(2000); } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; } const book = await k.server(k.K); if (!activated || rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId !== 'open') throw new Error('the checkpoint did not activate'); if (!raced) throw new Error('the write never reached the conditional commit: ' + JSON.stringify(calls)); if (book.entries[1].content !== 'race-edit') throw new Error('the write landing after the race overwrote the other page edit: ' + JSON.stringify(calls)); if (book.entries[0].disable !== true) throw new Error('the refused write still flipped the gated entry'); if (!calls.some((c) => c.kind === 'commit' && c.status === 409) || calls.some((c) => c.kind === 'edit')) throw new Error('expected one refused commit and no ST save: ' + JSON.stringify(calls)); return { refused: 'conditional commit 409', serverOther: book.entries[1].content, gateStillOff: true, calls };

const k = globalThis.__k12r; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.activateCheckpoint('start'); await k.pause(1500); await rt.activateCheckpoint('open'); await k.pause(2000); const book = await k.server(k.K); if (book.entries[1].content !== 'race-edit') throw new Error('the retried write overwrote the other page edit'); if (book.entries[0].disable !== false) throw new Error('the retried write did not enable the gated entry'); return { retried: 'landed through the commit with the edit kept' };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__k12r.pause(800); return { authorView: false };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = (ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings ??= {}); const was = globalThis.__k12r.was; const worldInfo = { ...(root.worldInfo ?? {}) }; if (was.gatingMode === undefined) delete worldInfo.gatingMode; else worldInfo.gatingMode = was.gatingMode; root.worldInfo = worldInfo; ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorScanGating?.sync(); return { restored: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode };
